title: Use Teaching Tips to Educate and Guide Users

features.name: Teaching Tips
features.description: Teaching tips are a valuable method for educating users about what they can do on a particular page. They should be brief, focus on key value rather than how to use the page, and allow users to find relevant documentation.
caveats: Cannot be used to prescribe a certain business process
Sequence is controlled by order on page top to bottom
Users may skip or ignore if too many are used
Should be limited to three most important things

features.name: Tours with Teaching Tips
features.description: Tours with teaching tips can point to particular actions or fields and provide explanations. They are a better choice for helping users discover key elements on a page.
caveats: Sequence determined by page order top to bottom

quotes.text: teaching tips are a valuable method for educating users about what they can do in a particular particular page
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the primary purpose and value of teaching tips as a user education tool.

quotes.text: be brief make sure the user understands the key value of the page as if you would introduce it in one sentence
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the design principle that teaching tips should focus on key value, not procedures.

quotes.text: you can't use teaching tips to prescribe a certain business process
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines a critical limitation of teaching tips - they cannot be used for process workflows.

quotes.text: the sequence of the teaching tips is controlled by the order they appear on the page top to bottom
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the technical constraint that teaching tips follow page layout order, not custom sequencing.

quotes.text: shorter and fewer tips is usually better if you try to communicate too much
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides best practice guidance on balancing coverage with user engagement.

quotes.text: narrow it down and think about the three most important things us just really need to discover and understand
quotes.why_it_matters: Gives the concrete limit on how many teaching tips to use, which the summary and key points state.
